Vanessa / Samantha —

Thanks. Quick legal guidance after reviewing the attached order form: the bifurcated delivery is acceptable with conditions. Below are the minimal, clean requirements the broker should include on the endorsement and COI text to avoid blocking procurement. Please have the broker confirm exact language before we sign.

1) Certificate of Insurance (COI) — must include:
- Policy types: Commercial General Liability (CGL), Automobile Liability (if vehicles will be used), Employers' Liability / Workers' Comp as required by local law, and Professional Liability (Errors & Omissions) where services include development/inference integration.
- Limits: CGL $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate (or as stated in order form); E&O $2,000,000 aggregate (if called out).
- Named Insured and Insurer details, policy numbers, and policy effective/expiration dates.
- A statement that the COI is provided as interim evidence pending endorsement.

2) Endorsement (Additional Insured) — minimum language we need on insurer letterhead or standard ISO endorsement form:
"The insurer hereby endorses the policy to name Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents as Additional Insureds with respect to liability arising out of the operations of the Named Insured under that policy. Coverage afforded to Additional Insureds shall be primary and non-contributory to the extent permitted by law."
3) Timing and cure:
- 10 business days is acceptable as a standard window, provided Aquila confirms it in writing at signature and the COI explicitly states it is interim evidence.
- If endorsement is not delivered within 10 business days, Redwood may temporarily suspend provisioning until proof is delivered; we prefer escalation before suspension but must preserve that right.

4) Waiver of subrogation — not required in all cases, but if Aquila's carrier requires it we can evaluate on a case-by-case basis.

5) Special note on cyber/E&O: if the order includes access to customer data or API keys for production environments, the E&O/cyber policy must not exclude claims arising from professional services. Please ask the broker to confirm policy wording or provide a redline.

Samantha — if you can have the broker return a COI with the interim language and confirm they'll provide the endorsement wording above, we can proceed with signature and close the deal by Dec 1. Marcus / Vanessa, I left escalation language intentionally minimal to keep procurement moving; tell me if you want to tighten the suspension/cure terms.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
